# Wired Geese

Wired Geese is Alex Gusev's public software-making practice. The normal website is for human readers; selected long-form Journal resources are also available as canonical English Markdown for AI agents.

The human website is maintained in English (`en`), Russian (`ru`), and Spanish (`es`). For a selected article, localized `.html` URLs are the human SSR presentations. Only the English `.md` URL is the direct agent representation.

Start with the Journal and these Markdown resources:

- https://wiredgeese.com/en/blog/2026/20260910-01-current-work-evidence.md
- https://wiredgeese.com/en/blog/2026/20260810-01-teqfw-agent-skills.md
- https://wiredgeese.com/en/blog/2026/20260721-02-why-dependency-injection-matters-in-javascript.md

Useful human entry points: https://wiredgeese.com/en/, https://wiredgeese.com/en/projects.html, and https://wiredgeese.com/en/blog/.
